headline: Argentina Tractor Maker Pauny Confronts Unpaid Wages and Bounced Checks
summary: Argentine tractor manufacturer Pauny is facing union conflicts and worker demands over millions in bounced checks and unpaid salary and social security contributions at its 450-worker plant.
why: Pauny is a historic manufacturer of agricultural tractors in Argentina, serving as an indicator of broader domestic farm equipment demand and liquidity pressures.

impacts.name: Pauny SA
impacts.why: Dishonored checks and labor unrest create serious operational and financial distress.
